profile.summary: Arshiya Limited provides integrated supply chain and logistics infrastructure solutions in India. The company operates in two segments, Free Trade Warehousing Zones (FTWZ)/Special Economic Zone (SEZ) and Domestic Warehousing. It develops and operates FTWZs that include integrated logistics infrastructure comprising storage areas, material handling equipment, container yards, inland container depot
